hooks.command:
cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:];&|])(gh pr (create|edit)|git push)([[:space:]]|$)'; then jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", additionalContext: "Pre-PR checklist (acknowledge each before proceeding):
- [ ] Diff swept for superfluous comments (six-months-cold-reader test).
- [ ] PR title reflects the final diff.
- [ ] PR body reflects the final branch state (no stale test-plan items, no removed features still mentioned).
- [ ] Locally-runnable test-plan items run (make check, relevant tests).
- [ ] Root cause fully identified: keep investigating until the actual root cause is named in the PR body. Do not stop at the first symptom.
- [ ] Workaround is only permitted if the root cause is impossible to fix on our end (name the blocker, link the tracking entry). Otherwise, fix the root cause in this PR."}}'; fi
